label.@authored: evility God of Destruction (480): adapted - DD2 'Deal damage to a random number of enemy units at end of turn' (value 5): EBOOT 0xFB984 draws the count 0x1A0CCC(5) + 1 (1..5) and picks that many DISTINCT random hostile units. Rule carried: D5 Punishing Prophecy (6112, alias 24480) still hits its one drawn victim at the holder's end of turn, then kit row 24480 (random_victims 5, wrap_victims at the game's append call) adds game_rng_draw(5) more distinct hostile victims, so the count is 1..5, same candidate rules as D5's own list. Not carried: the damage per victim is D5's own Punishing Prophecy action (magic row 21, power 100); DD2's action row 10484 differs from Plum's 10474 in two bytes (+0x112 2 vs 3, +0x127 130 vs 100) whose meaning was not decoded, so DD2's damage is not reproduced

label.@authored: evility The Artifact (80): adapted - DD2 'Deals damage equal to N% of max HP to attackers of this unit' (value 20; mskill text and value from dd2source). the percent is of the ATTACKER's max HP per the community evility list (GameFAQs 'Disgaea D2: A Brighter Darkness - Evility List', Dark_Cecil: attackers lose 20% of THEIR max HP) and the Disgaea wiki; the Disgaea D2 code for this effect was NOT FOUND (EBOOT evility accessors, DD2EVIL1 section 3), so this is community evidence, not source code, and which attacks trigger it is unsettled. Carried by D5's own Malicious Reflect (143, alias row 26306) with kit row 26306 (max_hp_reflect 20): at the one damage_skill_dat call of the reflect rider in FUN_1401ADA40 (0x1401AE531, wrap_maxrefl) the hurt amount becomes 20% of the attacker's max HP (truncated, float arithmetic of the game) instead of 10% of the damage taken. D5's own rules stay: every damaging hit that reaches the rider triggers it (melee and ranged, as Malicious Reflect does), the game's clamp keeps the attacker at 1 HP or more (it never kills), and a unit holding the real 143 alone is unchanged. Not carried: the source's conditions for counters and special attacks (unknown), damage that is not a hit (poison, geo)

label.@authored: evility Basic Principles (640): adapted - DD2 'Won't target allies when attacking, and won't be targeted by allies' (value 0, no number; the Disgaea D2 targeting code was not opened). Two halves on D5's rules. (1) 'won't be targeted by allies' = D5 Softening Aura (2072, 'Nullify damage taken from ally units'; alias row 26307): the game's own test at the top of damage_nullify_predicate nullifies a hit whose attacker is on the holder's side. (2) 'won't target allies when attacking' = kit row 26307 (nullify_dealt, wrap_nullify): a hit with positive damage by the holder on a unit the SAME game test (events_env_team_of through cmdmenu_preds_p_2d8e00: team groups 0/4, 1/5, 3) calls an ally is nullified. Not carried: an ally can still be SELECTED as a target and the animation plays, only the damage is removed; heals and buffs to allies are untouched (the source says 'attacking'); the AI is not told; damage that is not a hit (poison, geo) and the seven other call sites of damage_nullify_predicate that the kit does not redirect (evility.py NULLIFY comment) are not covered; a hit on the holder itself by the holder counts as an ally hit (the game's test says so for 2072)

evility Heavy Stance (300): exact rule - DD2 'Cannot be lifted' (value 0, no number); kit flight row 24300 makes D5's own can't-be-carried test (the 124/1224/5000 check in cannot_be_carried_by) true for the holder, with none of D5 Heavy Stance's stats +30%; replaces the alias to D5 1224. DD2's own predicate also counts 580 T.O. Analyze (not Pringer Z)
